status: released: @fiestaboard/ui 8.3.0 (tag v8.3.0, commit 2250b760), which ships FiestaUI #341 (squash-merged as 4a5cd25d). Re-vendored from the release tag.
note: Every file is byte-identical to its blob at `commit` (the v8.3.0 release). #341 changed device-models.json only: divoom_pixoo64 streams at maxFps 5 (hardware lab 2, 2026-10-05: single-frame pushes at 5 fps show every core-planned transition), where it was 2 and snapped; every other file is identical at the v8.1.0 tag (0f73bc40). Before #341: Every file is byte-identical to its blob at `commit` (the v8.1.0 release). #342 changed device-model.schema.json (layoutOptions.font: the faces a board may choose; declared, the model must declare font, allowed must include it and charset must be the built-in set drawn in it), device-models.json (divoom_pixoo64 offers ["5x7", "3x5"], default "5x7", and keeps font 3x5 / charset led_3x5) and led-golden.json (case "pixoo 5x7 large grid"); every other file is identical at the v8.0.0 tag (6b7dbbc9). Before #342: Every file is byte-identical to its blob at `commit`, except where `files_from` names another commit. #338 changed device-model.schema.json (optional layoutOptions, LED only), device-models.json (every built-in LED model allows both tileGap values and both blockPadding values, with today's defaults) and led-golden.json (14 layout cases and one flip case for the two options, design spec section 7.6). #338 branched from main before #336, so plugin-models.json stays at 22db0b5 (#336: FiestaPanel split-flap streams at 0.5 fps); every other file is identical at both commits. Before #338: Every file is byte-identical to its blob at the commit. The batch changed device-models.json (Vestaboard flagship/note/note_array stream at 1 fps, panel at 0.5 fps; the Pixoo 64 streams at 2 fps and snaps), led-golden.json (the flip budget keeps the scramble and shortens the stagger first; the 32-frame budget cases run on an inlined generic sequence device, sequence_panel_64) and charset-golden.json (kiosk_mono_v1 and five supported-icon cases). device-models.json and charset-golden.json are unchanged since cb500a8 (#326), led-golden.json since ff8186e (#328); everything else is unchanged since 95423b31c1446bfc6c6d7f62b901cbb16c21d147.
